summary.text: London Lamar is a Democratic state senator from Memphis who represents Tennessee Senate District 33 in part of Shelby County and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
She served in the Tennessee House before joining the Senate and serves on the Senate Finance, Ways and Means and Judiciary committees.

paragraphs.text: London Lamar was born on December 29, 1990, and earned a B.A. in political science, with minors in sociology and intercultural studies, from Saint Mary's College in Notre Dame, Indiana.

Lamar served in the Tennessee House of Representatives in the 111th and 112th General Assemblies, including as House Democratic Caucus Secretary in the 112th, and has been a member of the Senate since the 112th.
She is a former president of the Tennessee Young Democrats and serves as secretary of the Tennessee Black Caucus of State Legislators.
She was an at-large Tennessee delegate to the 2016 Democratic National Convention.
